# Token Board: ABA Reward Chart (token-board.app), formerly ABA Token Board, App Store ID 6752328327

> Token Board: ABA Reward Chart (listed as "ABA Token Board" until September 2026) is a free digital token board and reward chart app for ABA therapy, autism support, classrooms and home, made by Natalia Jakubczyk-Gajewska (Apps for Parents). A child earns visual tokens for target behaviors and trades a full board for a reward they chose in advance. Everything is picture-based, so pre-readers and nonverbal children can use it fully. It is designed for ABA therapists, special-education and general-education teachers, and parents.

Website: https://token-board.app
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6752328327?pt=118868513&ct=webnew&mt=8

## Key facts

- Best for: parents, teachers and ABA therapists who want a digital token board a child taps on an iPhone or iPad, ready in a minute, with no printing, laminating or lost Velcro pieces. Works for pre-readers and nonverbal children.
- Platform: Token Board: ABA Reward Chart runs on iPhone, iPad and Mac. There is no Android version.
- Price: free to download. The free version includes the full token board; Token Board Plus removes the limits via in-app purchase (plans and prices are shown in the app).
- Ads: none. Anonymous usage statistics only, no ad tracking.
- Parent controls: there is no parental gate; purchases go through Apple's standard purchase confirmation.
- Works offline: yes. The app is picture-based, so no reading is required.
- Ages: for children from about 2 to 12 and any learner in ABA therapy. App Store age rating 4+. Rated 4.6 / 5 stars from 26 App Store ratings.
- Boards: 3 to 100 tokens per board, 40+ token icons, rewards from the built-in library or your own photo, a board per child or task, confetti when the board is full.
- Languages: 7 — English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Portuguese and Spanish.
- App size: 33.9 MB
- Not the same app as My Token Board, Token Board GO or Token Board ABA: Token Board: ABA Reward Chart is made by Natalia Jakubczyk-Gajewska, App Store ID 6752328327, website token-board.app. Those three are different apps from other developers.
- Disclaimer: the app is a support tool, not a substitute for professional advice from a BCBA or clinician

## Guides

- [What Is a Token Board in ABA?](https://token-board.app/guides/what-is-a-token-board.html): What a token board means in ABA therapy, how it works, and a worked example — tokens, goals and backup reinforcers explained.
- [Token Economy for Autism](https://token-board.app/guides/token-economy-autism.html): Step-by-step token economy setup for children with autism: target behaviors, tokens, exchange rates and consistency.
- [How to Use a Token Board](https://token-board.app/guides/how-to-use-a-token-board.html): How many tokens to start with, when to award them, mistakes to avoid, and how to fade the token board over time.
- [Free Printable Token Board?](https://token-board.app/guides/printable-token-board.html): Print-and-laminate token boards compared with a free digital token board that is ready in 60 seconds.
- [Token Boards in the Classroom](https://token-board.app/guides/token-board-classroom.html): How teachers use token boards for on-task behavior, transitions and routines, in special education and general education.
- [Reward Chart App for Kids](https://token-board.app/guides/reward-chart-app.html): Using the app as a digital sticker chart / reward chart for chores, routines and homework, with photo rewards.
- [Token Boards for ADHD](https://token-board.app/guides/token-board-adhd.html): Why immediate feedback, visible progress and short winnable goals suit kids with ADHD, at home or school.
- [50 Token Board Reward Ideas](https://token-board.app/guides/token-board-reward-ideas.html): Reinforcer ideas — free rewards, activities, sensory favorites and small prizes — and how to find what motivates your child.
